study.title: Differential cerebral response to somatosensory stimulation of an acupuncture point vs. two non-acupuncture points measured with EEG and fMRI
study.study_design: blinded study including two series of experiments (one with EEG, one with fMRI) focusing on brain activity changes associated with complex somatosensory stimulation at one acupuncture point and two control points either close or distant to the acupuncture point
study.randomization: The order was randomized; the three event-related scans were in randomized order over subjects; the inter-stimulus interval was randomized from 13 to 21 s.
study.blinding: Participants were informed about the needle stimulation; subjects were blinded regarding the character of the different point locations and the researchers were blinded during the pre-processing of the data and during the first steps of data interpretation.
study.inclusion_criteria: right-handed according to the Edinburgh inventory and gave written informed consent; prior to participation all subjects underwent a comprehensive neurological examination and confirmed they were not taking any acute or chronic medication

arms.dropouts: In the EEG experiment three subjects were excluded from acupuncture because of vegetative side effects (1 sweating/male, 2 dizziness/female); in the fMRI experiment one was excluded (sweating/female).

neuroimaging_methods.scanner_manufacturer_model_exact: 3T Siemens Verio MRI System (Siemens Medical, Erlangen, Germany) equipped for echo planer imaging with a 12-channel head coil; 32-channel EEG recorded using BrainAmp (Brain Product, Germany)
neuroimaging_methods.sequence_exact: EPI sequence; T1-weighted MPRAGE sequence; EEG sampling rate 1000 Hz
neuroimaging_methods.TR_exact: repetition time = 2000 ms for fMRI; structural image repetition time = 12 ms
neuroimaging_methods.TE_exact: echo time = 30 ms for fMRI; structural image echo time = 5.65 ms
neuroimaging_methods.voxel_size_exact: 30 axial slices, in-plane resolution is 3 × 3 × 5 mm, slice thickness = 4 mm, gap = 5 mm; structural image voxel size of 1 × 1 × 1 mm
neuroimaging_methods.scan_duration_exact: each fMRI scan 6 min; EEG recorded for 25.5 min
neuroimaging_methods.preprocessing_software_exact: SPM 8 software package; DPABI toolbox; REST toolbox; custom-built scripts in Matlab; FastICA algorithm in Matlab
neuroimaging_methods.smoothing_exact: spatial smoothing with a 6 mm FWHM
neuroimaging_methods.motion_exclusion_exact: six head motion parameters were included as nuisance regressors; subjects’ heads were immobilized by cushioned supports
neuroimaging_methods.filtering_exact: EEG digitally filtered using a standard 3rd order band-pass Butterworth filter (low cut-off 1 Hz, high cut-off 45 Hz); resting-state temporal band-pass filtering (0.01–0.08 Hz) and removal of linear trend
primary_neuroimaging_metrics: EEG mu rhythm power spectral density (10–15 Hz) at Cz
seed-based functional connectivity; Fisher's z maps
statistical_thresholds_exact: AlphaSim in AFNI alpha-level <0.05 (39429 voxels within gray matter mask, voxel-wise p < 0.0001, resulting cluster size >108 mm3) for main effects and one-sample resting-state maps
AlphaSim in AFNI alpha-level <0.05 (39429 voxels within gray matter mask, voxel-wise p < 0.01, resulting cluster size >783 mm3) for interpoint comparisons and conjunction maps
Bonferroni corrected 0.05/3 for EEG primary outcome parameter
neuroimaging_methods.multiple_comparison_correction_exact: AlphaSim in AFNI; Bonferroni correction for EEG pair-wise comparison between the three stimulation points
